fields.subject: SqlConnectionConfiguration
fields.where: a Configuration hierarchy supplies InitialCatalog and DataSource values across global, shard-set, read/write, shard, and local layers
fields.trigger: a caller reads ConnectionDescription before a connection string has set it
fields.response: return database {InitialCatalog} on server {DataSource} using the last non-empty value for each field in global, shard-set, read/write, shard, then local order
fields.postcondition: a later layer may replace the database name independently of the server name
